ios.desc:
Elevate your network analysis with UDP TCP Network Utility!

UDP TCP Network Utility empowers you to easily manage UDP and TCP communication, analyze networks, establish direct connections between clients and servers, perform comprehensive network diagnostics, ping devices, websites, and hosts, and scan all devices on your network. Whether you’re a professional or just interested in network communication, this app provides everything you need to work efficiently and accurately.

Send and Receive UDP

•	Effortlessly manage UDP traffic
•	Send and receive packets with precision
•	Ideal for testing network responses
•	Manage communications between devices
•	Supports multiple data formats for flexible and efficient UDP communication

TCP Client and Server

•	Establish reliable TCP connections as both a client and a server
•	Handle multiple connections simultaneously
•	Perfect for scenarios requiring guaranteed data delivery (e.g., file transfers, secure communications)

Bidirectional Data Transmission

•	Support for bidirectional data transmission in both UDP and TCP protocols
•	Ensures seamless two-way communication
•	Critical for interactive applications and real-time data processing

Support for Multiple Encodings

•	Customize data transmission with support for HEX, UTF-8, Base64, and ASCII encodings
•	Ensure compatibility with various network protocols and data formats
•	Facilitate easy integration into your existing network setup

Manage Network Devices

•	Easily add and organize network devices
•	Specify IP addresses, ports, names, and protocols
•	Streamline device management
•	Allow quick connections to any device as needed

Ping Devices, Websites, and Hosts

•	Perform quick and accurate ping operations
•	Test the reachability of devices, websites, and hosts
•	Essential for diagnosing network issues
•	Measure round-trip times and ensure network reliability

LAN Scanner

•	Scan all devices on your local network
•	Identify and manage connected devices efficiently
•	Provides detailed information about every device on your network
•	Make it easier to manage and secure your network environment

Extensive Settings

•	Tailor the app to your workflow with various settings
•	Include timestamps in logs
•	Customize encoding/decoding
•	Set a timer for sending repeated messages
•	Enhance automation and ensure accurate data handling

Save and Load Network Devices

•	Save your network configurations for quick access later
•	Ideal for professionals managing multiple net
